mapper.sql: rv.setting_id as "settingId", rv.evaluation_year as "evaluationYear", rv.college_organization_code as "collegeOrganizationCode", rv.department_organization_code as "departmentOrganizationCode", rv.view_start_at as "viewStartAt", rv.view_end_at as "viewEndAt", rv.visibility_scope as "visibilityScope", rv.active_yn as "activeYn", rv.created_by as "createdBy", rv.updated_by as "updatedBy", rv.created_at as "createdAt", rv.updated_at as "updatedAt", rv.change_reason as "changeReason"

where.if: and (rv.evaluation_year ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or rv.college_organization_code ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or rv.department_organization_code ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or rv.visibility_scope ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%'))

and exists ( select 1 from evaluation_organization_mappings eom where eom.user_id = #{criteria.requesterUserId} and eom.organization_code in (rv.college_organization_code, rv.department_organization_code) and eom.business_type = 'FACULTY_ACHIEVEMENT' and eom.data_scope in ('DEPARTMENT','COLLEGE','BUSINESS','ALL') )

mapper.select:
select from result_view_period_settings rv
order by rv.evaluation_year desc, rv.college_organization_code, rv.department_organization_code, rv.visibility_scope, rv.view_start_at desc limit #{criteria.safeSize} offset #{criteria.offset}

insert into result_view_period_settings (evaluation_year, college_organization_code, department_organization_code, view_start_at, view_end_at, visibility_scope, active_yn, change_reason, created_by, updated_by) values (#{request.evaluationYear}, #{request.collegeOrganizationCode}, #{request.departmentOrganizationCode}, #{request.viewStartAt}, #{request.viewEndAt}, #{request.visibilityScope}, #{request.activeYn}, #{request.changeReason}, #{userId}, #{userId}) returning setting_id as "settingId", evaluation_year as "evaluationYear", college_organization_code as "collegeOrganizationCode", department_organization_code as "departmentOrganizationCode", view_start_at as "viewStartAt", view_end_at as "viewEndAt", visibility_scope as "visibilityScope", active_yn as "activeYn", created_by as "createdBy", updated_by as "updatedBy", created_at as "createdAt", updated_at as "updatedAt", change_reason as "changeReason"

update result_view_period_settings set evaluation_year = #{request.evaluationYear}, college_organization_code = #{request.collegeOrganizationCode}, department_organization_code = #{request.departmentOrganizationCode}, view_start_at = #{request.viewStartAt}, view_end_at = #{request.viewEndAt}, visibility_scope = #{request.visibilityScope}, active_yn = #{request.activeYn}, change_reason = #{request.changeReason}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{userId} where setting_id = #{request.settingId} returning setting_id as "settingId", evaluation_year as "evaluationYear", college_organization_code as "collegeOrganizationCode", department_organization_code as "departmentOrganizationCode", view_start_at as "viewStartAt", view_end_at as "viewEndAt", visibility_scope as "visibilityScope", active_yn as "activeYn", created_by as "createdBy", updated_by as "updatedBy", created_at as "createdAt", updated_at as "updatedAt", change_reason as "changeReason"
mapper.insert: insert into data_change_histories (target_business, target_key, change_type, field_name, before_value, after_value, changed_by, change_reason, request_id) values (#{targetBusiness}, #{targetKey}, #{changeType}, #{fieldName}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, #{changedBy}, #{changeReason}, #{requestId})
